our_title: bdgraphGatherAll allocation failures are not agreed upon in release builds; one failing process desynchronises the gather
ran: cd $WORK/repro/common; ./scan.sh ../../basefi/lib ./bin_basefi/bipartfi 3 1 0 30 -- 4elt.grf 0 'q{strat=f}' 0 1 -> nth=3: '(1): ERROR: bdgraphGatherAll: out of memory (1)', rank 1 prints 'rank 1: ret=1', then '*** MPI_ERRORS_ARE_FATAL (processes in this communicator will now abort' (exit 15); same at nth=4 (out of memory (2)) and nth=5 (out of memory (4)). Patched (buildfi): nth=3,4,5 -> 'rank 0: ret=1', 'rank 1: ret=1', 'rank 2: ret=1' (repro/DMO-03/scan_*.txt).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/bdgraph_gather_all.c:121-171 (release path '#ifndef SCOTCH_DEBUG_BDGRAPH1 bgraphExit (cgrfptr); return (1);' at :123-125, :132-134, :145-147, :164-166; the agreement at :172-181 is compiled only under SCOTCH_DEBUG_BDGRAPH1)
evidence: bdgraph_gather_all.c:121-125: 'if ((cgrfptr->frontab = (Gnum *) memAlloc (cgrfptr->s.vertnbr * sizeof (Gnum))) == NULL) { errorPrint ("bdgraphGatherAll: out of memory (1)"); #ifndef SCOTCH_DEBUG_BDGRAPH1 bgraphExit (cgrfptr); return (1);' while the other processes continue to commAllgatherv (:203) / MPI_Allgather (:218). bdgraphGatherAll runs in every bdgraphBipartSq call, i.e. at the coarsest levels of the default dgmap/dgpart strategy (q{strat=...}).

fix_options.label: A: assume-error / goto fail / unconditional agreement, as in the maintainer's hdgraphGather() rework (7.0.17)
fix_options.summary: Set all pointers before the first allocation, jump to a common fail label, always MPI_Allreduce the local status before any collective, free only what was allocated.
fix_options.tested: scan above (nth 3,4,5 now return 1 on all ranks); full CHECKPTSCOTCH on 32-bit, 64-bit and DEBUG_ALL trees (see SUMMARY.md)
fix_options.tradeoffs: One MPI_Allreduce per bdgraphGatherAll call in release builds (it existed in debug builds already); same structure as hdgraphGather() and as G18's dgraphGatherAll2 rework.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He did exactly this in 7.0.17 for hdgraphGather() ('Rework error handling and structure of `hdgraphGather()`', unconditional MPI_Allreduce after a fail: label) and G18 did it for dgraphGatherAll2(), which this routine calls.

fix_options.label: B: keep the debug-only agreement, document the limitation
fix_options.summary: No code change; accept that an OOM in the centralized gather hangs or aborts the job in release builds.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Zero cost, but the whole job dies on a single-process OOM, which the review and G18 treat as a defect.

our_title: bdgraphGatherAll allocates but never gathers the external gain array when the distributed graph has no part array
ran: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib mpirun -np 3 ./bin_build/bipartfi 4elt.grf 0 gather 1 0 -> 'rank 0: gather veextax=0x530000020400 bad=14280 of 15606' (np=1: same); 'q{strat=f}' with veex -> 'bgraph_bipart_gg.c:234:17: runtime error: signed integer overflow: -1094795308 + -1094795582' (0xBEBEBEBE = uninitialised heap), check=96. Patched: 'bad=0 of 15606', check=0 (repro/DMO-19/probes_*.txt).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/bdgraph_gather_all.c:197-215 (early return at :197-201 precedes the veextax commAllgatherv at :209-215)
evidence: bdgraph_gather_all.c:197: 'if (dgrfptr->partgsttax == NULL) { bgraphZero (cgrfptr); memFree (froncnttab); return (0); }' then :209 'if (dgrfptr->veexloctax != NULL) { if (commAllgatherv (dgrfptr->veexloctax + ...'. Latent: veexloctax is NULL today (bdgraph.c:98 'No external gain (yet)').

fix_options.label: A: gather the external gains before testing for the part array
fix_options.summary: Move the veextax commAllgatherv block above the 'partgsttax == NULL' early return.
fix_options.tested: gather mode bad=0 at np=1,3; veex strategies q, q+x, m with fold n/f/d at np=1..4 pass bdgraphCheck on release and DEBUG_ALL trees
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Minimal, keeps his structure; the gathered graph must be complete before any sequential method runs on it.

fix_options.label: B: free veextax and set it to NULL on the early-return path
fix_options.summary: Do not gather external gains when no part array exists; the sequential strategy then runs without them.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Silently drops the external gains of the first sequential bipartition (wrong objective); not acceptable.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He wants the feature wired through (TODO in bdgraphInit).

our_title: bdgraphBipartMlUncoarsen omits the external gain of received part-0 vertices
ran: With patches 0001-0007 and the coarse-gain merge applied but without this fix: mpirun -np 2 ./bin_build/bipartfi 4elt.grf 0 'm{asc=x{bal=0},low=q{strat=f},seq=q{strat=f},fold=n,dvert=100000,vert=100}' 1 1 -> '(0): ERROR: bdgraphCheck: invalid global communication gains', check=64 on all ranks (np=2,3,4, fold n/f/d); np=1 passes. With the fix: check=0 everywhere (repro/DMO-19/probes_patched_*.txt).
evidence: bdgraph_bipart_ml.c:614 'finepartgsttax[finevertlocnum] = 0;' with no gain update, whereas the local branch does :458 'finecommlocgainextn += veexval * (1 - 2 * coarpartmsk);' (+veex for part 0) and the part-1 sub-arrays do :640 'finecommlocgainextn -= veexval;'. commglbgainextn = sum veex * (1 - 2 * part) therefore lacks +veex for every part-0 fine vertex whose multinode is held by another process.

fix_options.label: A: add the +veex term in the two part-0 receive loops
fix_options.summary: 'if (fineveexloctax != NULL) finecommlocgainextn += fineveexloctax[finevertlocnum];' after the part assignment in sub-arrays 0 and 2.
fix_options.tested: veex ml probes with fold n/f/d, np 1..4, release and DEBUG_ALL trees: check=0
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Mirrors the existing part-1 branches; symmetric code.

fix_options.label: B: recompute commglbgainextn from scratch after the halo exchange
fix_options.summary: Loop over all local vertices at the end of uncoarsening and sum veex*(1-2*part), dropping the incremental accounting.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Simpler invariant but an extra pass over all local vertices at every level; departs from the incremental style of the routine.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He keeps the incremental accounting everywhere (bd, df, ex).

our_title: dgmap with a plain target file name aborts on non-root processes (target file opened on root only)
ran: cd $WORK/repro/common; echo 'cmplt 7' > cmplt7.tgt; mpirun --oversubscribe -np 2 ../../build/bin/dgmap 4elt.grf cmplt7.tgt /dev/null -> 'dgmap(1): ERROR: main: target architecture file not provided', rc=1 (np=3: 2 such errors, np=4: 3); np=1 works; same on the 64-bit tree and on base-combined (the tool is not touched by this series). dgpart and dgord work at np=1..4 (repro/tools_np_runs.txt).
read_only: src/scotch/dgmap.c:361 'fileBlockOpenDist (C_fileTab, C_FILENBR, procglbnbr, proclocnum, protglbnum)' opens single-named files on the root process only; :377-379 'if (C_filepntrtgtinp == NULL) errorPrint ("main: target architecture file not provided"); SCOTCH_archLoad (&archdat, C_filepntrtgtinp);' runs on every process. Whether a '%p'/'%r' file name pattern is the intended usage was not checked (CLI group).
why_not_run: the cause was read, not patched: src/scotch/ belongs to the CLI group; could be intended usage (per-process file names)

fix_options.label: A: load the architecture on the root process and broadcast it, or open the target file on every process
fix_options.summary: Either read the architecture on protglbnum and broadcast its description, or let fileBlockOpenDist open read-only single-named files on all processes.
fix_options.tested: untested: other group's tool, design to be decided
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Unknown; to be routed to the CLI group.
